class: A costly result kept only in the step that uses it, so every failure before that step pays for it again
symptom: Writer (Ashby), 28 September: 14 attempts at one application each asked the AI to tailor the resume again, spending the day's AI allowance on the same document.
root_cause: prepare_materials wrote the tailored resume to the job's output folder, but it was filed in the database (where reuse_stored_document looks) only once the run reached the application form. A run that failed earlier -- the browser, a sign-in, a stop -- left nothing to reuse.
why_tests_missed: No test covered prepare_materials across two runs; reuse was only ever exercised on a run whose resume had already been filed.
fix: prepare_materials files the resume in the database as soon as it is written. The store is keyed by content hash, so filing it again later adds nothing.
prevention: Save anything that costs money or quota the moment it exists, in the place later attempts look, and test a second attempt after a failed first.
